about_the_game:
YOOCA: Next Horizon is a social life simulation game where your actions, skills, and interactions shape your story.

In this exclusive demo, you’ll get a taste of the YOOCA experience with access to:

🔹 Avatar Customization – Design and personalize your look
🔹 Skill Progression – Gain skills by performing different actions
🔹 Player Traits – Boost traits like Strength by how you live and play
🔹 Social Interactions – Use emotes and chat to connect with others
🔹 Mini-Games – Try out a selection of fun and fast-paced games
🔹 One Quest – Complete a guided quest to see how progression works

This demo is just the beginning — your feedback helps shape the world we’re building.

Jump in. Customize. Explore. Interact.
Start your journey in YOOCA: Next Horizon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 5600G or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)

short_description: Jump into a social life sim where every action builds your character. Customize your avatar, level up skills, boost traits, and connect with others using emotes and chat. Play mini-games, complete a quest, and help shape the future—starting with this exclusive demo.
